extracted.intended_audience: NPR readers and general public interested in television, comedy, and culture
extracted.subtask_description: A short news article summarizing Dave Chappelle's public response to criticism over transphobic material in his Netflix special, including employee backlash, a walkout, and conditions he set for meeting upset Netflix employees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must have watched the special from beginning to end
rubrics_metrics.description: "You cannot come if you have not watched my special from beginning to end."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of three conditions Chappelle stipulates for Netflix employees who wish to meet with him; stated in a five-minute Instagram video as a prerequisite to any meeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting must be at a place and time of his choosing
rubrics_metrics.description: "You must come to a place of my choosing, at a time of my choosing."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chappelle's second stated condition for meeting with critical Netflix employees, indicating he controls logistical terms of any meeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employees must admit that Hannah Gadsby is not funny
rubrics_metrics.description: "And thirdly, you must admit that Hannah Gadsby is not funny."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chappelle's third, provocative condition for a meeting; references another comedian (Hannah Gadsby) and serves as an explicit rhetorical demand in his Instagram statement.
